headline: Binance to Reopen Withdrawals for Additional Assets Across Several Networks
summary: Binance announced it will resume withdrawals for more digital assets across multiple blockchain networks following maintenance operations.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume. Exchange deposit and withdrawal access directly affects asset transfer liquidity across global crypto markets.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: Resuming withdrawals restores asset mobility for users holding supported tokens on the platform.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
